confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.plain: The chance the shown forecast is right: for a climb or drop, that the player belongs at least that many divisions higher or lower; for a hold, that they belong in their current division.

shift.label: Manual shift
shift.plain: An organizer's manual override for this player (0 = none). Set by hand; recalculation never changes it.

impact.label: Impact
impact.plain: How much better or worse the player did than expected for the match-up — 0–100 within their role.

vs_local.label: vs similar players
vs_local.plain: Performance compared to players of the same role and nearby division (0 = average, ＋ above, − below).

points.label: Move signal
points.plain: The raw signal driving the division forecast — the larger it is, the stronger the up/down push.

recent_moves.label: Recent moves
recent_moves.plain: Division changes in the player's last two tournaments.

forecast_place.label: Forecast place
forecast_place.plain: Where the model expects the team to finish.

likely_range.label: Likely finish
likely_range.plain: Where the team lands in 80% of simulated tournaments (10th–90th percentile).

prob_top.label: Chance for top finish
prob_top.plain: Share of simulated tournaments where the team finished in the top N.

competitiveness.label: How close
competitiveness.plain: How back-and-forth the match was — 100 is a nail-biter, 0 is a blowout.

predictability.label: How expected
predictability.plain: How well the result matched the pre-match forecast — 100 means it went as expected.

skill_balance.label: How even
skill_balance.plain: How evenly matched the two teams' ratings were — 100 is a perfectly even match-up.

match_quality.label: Match quality
match_quality.plain: Overall watchability: a blend of how close, how expected and how even the match was.

forecast_miss.label: Forecast miss
forecast_miss.plain: How far the forecast landed from the real finish, in places.

evidence.label: Evidence
evidence.plain: Weighted amount of history behind the forecast — more evidence means more confidence.

newcomer.label: Newcomer
newcomer.plain: Playing their first tournament, or their first time in this role.

why_score.label: Why this score
why_score.plain: The player stats that pushed the impact score up or down the most.

smurf.label: Possible smurf
smurf.plain: Playing well above their division — could be a strong player on an under-ranked account.

throw.label: Possible throw
throw.plain: Looks like they stopped trying mid-series — play dropped sharply below their own usual level.

troll.label: Possible griefing
troll.plain: Repeatedly playing below their own level, dragging their team down.

sandbag.label: Possible sandbag
sandbag.plain: One unexpectedly weak tournament that stands out against the player's own track record.

climbing.label: Climbing
climbing.plain: Players the model thinks are playing above their division and should move up a tier.

dropping.label: Dropping
dropping.plain: Players performing below their division — the model leans toward moving them down a tier.

watch.label: Watch flags
watch.plain: Automatic heads-ups when someone's results look unusual. A prompt for a human to look — never a verdict.

avg_confidence.label: Average confidence
avg_confidence.plain: The average confidence of the players' forecasts across the whole bracket.

upsets.label: Upsets
upsets.plain: Teams that finished four or more places away from their predicted spot — the bracket's biggest surprises.

new_faces.label: New faces
new_faces.plain: Players new to the tournament, or playing a role they haven't before. Their numbers carry less weight until we see more.

predicted_move.label: Predicted move
predicted_move.plain: Climb or drop appears only when the model is at least 80% sure the player belongs in a higher or lower division, and the size is the largest move it is that sure of. Otherwise the player holds.

impact_percentile.label: Impact percentile
impact_percentile.plain: Where a player's impact ranks among others in the same role and division — 90 means they beat almost everyone at their level.

howItWorks.title: Reading the analytics
howItWorks.intro: When a tournament completes, or an organizer recalculates it, the model rates every player and team. This page turns that into three simple questions:
howItWorks.step1Body: The verdict up top names the team that beat its predicted finish by the most — and the one that fell short.
howItWorks.step2Body: Each player gets a predicted move — the model's read on whether they're playing above or below their current division.
howItWorks.step3Body: Confidence shows how much data is behind each call. Tap the ⓘ next to any figure to see what it means.
howItWorks.foot: Nothing here is final — the figures are recomputed when the tournament completes or an organizer recalculates.

round_robin.name: Round-robin
round_robin.description: Every team plays every other team. There is no knockout: places come from the standings, by points first and then by tiebreakers.

swiss.name: Swiss system
swiss.description: A fixed number of rounds. In each one, teams with the same record play each other: a win moves a team up a row, a loss moves it down, and rematches are avoided. The organizer may end a team's run early: enough wins and it is through, enough losses and it is out.

ffa_league.name: Free-for-all (FFA)
ffa_league.description: Teams are not paired off: the whole group plays in one lobby, several games in a row. Every game gives each team a placement and points, and the points add up into the standings.

single_elimination.name: Single elimination

double_elimination.name: Double elimination
double_elimination.description: Two brackets, upper and lower. The first loss drops a team into the lower bracket, the second knocks it out. The winners of both brackets meet in the grand final.

collection.body: When you sign in, your provider (Discord, Twitch, Battle.net, Riot Games, or Steam) gives us a stable account identifier, your username or display name, and your avatar; some providers also share an email address. As you use the site we also store what you generate directly: tournament registrations, match and map reports, draft picks, and any roles assigned to you. cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: {siteName} sets a session cookie to keep you signed in, a cookie recording your active workspace so a custom-domain workspace shows the right branding, a locale cookie for your language preference, and a time-zone cookie so dates show in your local time. These functional cookies are required for the site to work. Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica cookies, which measure how pages are used, are optional: they load only after you accept them in the cookie notice, and declining keeps them off. You can change that choice at any time from "Cookie settings" in the site footer; withdrawing it also deletes the analytics cookies already stored. No advertising cookies are set.

We share account data with OAuth providers only to the extent needed to authenticate you, and we don't otherwise share it with third parties.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Account and tournament data is kept for as long as your account exists, since match history and statistics remain part of the historical record of a tournament even after it ends. Infrastructure logs are rotated on a much shorter schedule.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can review the profile information tied to your account from your account settings. population_size.label: Population size
population_size.description: Number of candidate balances kept per generation. Higher values improve search coverage and cost more time.

generation_count.label: Generations
generation_count.description: Maximum optimization iterations. Higher values can improve quality and increase runtime.

mutation_rate.label: Mutation rate
mutation_rate.description: Probability that a solution is changed while producing the next generation.

mutation_strength.label: Mutation strength
mutation_strength.description: Number of swap/change operations attempted during a mutation.

average_mmr_balance_weight.label: Average MMR balance
average_mmr_balance_weight.description: Penalty weight for differences between team average MMR values.

team_total_balance_weight.label: Team total consistency
team_total_balance_weight.description: Penalty weight for standard deviation of total team rating sums.

max_team_gap_weight.label: Max team gap
max_team_gap_weight.description: Penalty weight for the rating gap between the strongest and weakest teams.

role_discomfort_weight.label: Role discomfort
role_discomfort_weight.description: Penalty weight for assigning players away from their preferred roles.

max_role_discomfort_weight.label: Worst discomfort
max_role_discomfort_weight.description: Penalty weight for the single worst role discomfort assignment in a solution.

role_line_balance_weight.label: Role line balance
role_line_balance_weight.description: Penalty weight for uneven rating strength between the same role across teams.

intra_team_std_weight.label: Intra-team rating std
intra_team_std_weight.description: Weight for the standard deviation of ratings inside each team. Higher values push the optimizer to spread top players across teams.

internal_role_spread_weight.label: Internal role spread
internal_role_spread_weight.description: Penalty weight for uneven average strength between roles inside the same team.

sub_role_collision_weight.label: Subrole collision
sub_role_collision_weight.description: Penalty weight per pair of players in the same team sharing the same role subclass, normalized per team count. Use 0 to disable.

low_rank_threshold.label: Low-rank threshold
low_rank_threshold.description: Players whose best role rating is at or below this value (canonical scale, see rating_scale_ceiling) count as low-rank; teams with two or more of them get penalized. 0 disables the mechanic.

low_rank_collision_weight.label: Low-rank pair penalty
low_rank_collision_weight.description: Penalty weight per pair of low-rank players in the same team, normalized per team count. Discourages stacking two low-rank players together.

team_max_pain_weight.label: Per-team worst discomfort
team_max_pain_weight.description: Penalty weight for the per-team maximum role discomfort averaged over all teams. Makes 'one suffering player in every team' visible, unlike the single global maximum.

rank_comfort_tilt.label: Rank tilt (balance <-> comfort)
rank_comfort_tilt.description: Shifts how result variants are ranked: 0.5 weighs team balance (StdDev) and comfort (off-role) equally; toward 1 prioritises comfort/off-role, toward 0 prioritises balance. Ordering and primary selection only — does not change the optimizer search.

role_settings.label: Role weights
role_settings.description: Per-role weights keyed by roster slot code: how much a role counts towards a team's effective total, and how hard uneven lines of it are penalized.

open_slot_settings.label: Open slot weights
open_slot_settings.description: Weights of open slots without a role constraint.

effective_total_std_weight.label: Effective total std
effective_total_std_weight.description: Penalty multiplier for weighted effective team-total standard deviation.

use_captains.label: Use captains
use_captains.description: Marks top-rated players as captains and uses them as team anchors when supported by the solver.

convergence_patience.label: Convergence patience
convergence_patience.description: Generations without meaningful Pareto improvement before early stopping can trigger.

convergence_epsilon.label: Convergence epsilon
convergence_epsilon.description: Minimum relative improvement required to continue once convergence patience is reached.

mutation_rate_min.label: Mutation rate min
mutation_rate_min.description: Lower bound for the adaptive mutation rate during Rust MOO search.

mutation_rate_max.label: Mutation rate max
mutation_rate_max.description: Upper bound for the adaptive mutation rate during Rust MOO search.

island_count.label: Island count
island_count.description: Number of independent Rust MOO islands explored in parallel before merging the archive.

polish_max_passes.label: Polish passes
polish_max_passes.description: Maximum local-improvement passes applied to each archive solution after the main search.

greedy_seed_count.label: Greedy seed count
greedy_seed_count.description: How many initial individuals are built with greedy seeding before random fill.

stagnation_kick_patience.label: Stagnation kick
stagnation_kick_patience.description: Generations without archive improvement before stronger mutation and crossover are applied.

crossover_rate.label: Crossover rate
crossover_rate.description: Probability of crossover when producing offspring in the Rust MOO search.

time_limit_ms.label: Time limit (ms)
time_limit_ms.description: Hard wall-clock budget for the optimizer in milliseconds. When exceeded, evolution and polishing stop early and the best result found so far is returned. Trades same-seed reproducibility for latency.

max_result_variants.label: Result variants
max_result_variants.description: Maximum number of solution variants returned by the selected solver.

impact.label: Impact
impact.description: Importance multiplier for this role's contribution when comparing effective team totals.

line_gap_weight.label: Line gap
line_gap_weight.description: Penalty multiplier for the largest gap between adjacent (sorted by strength) lines of this role.

line_std_weight.label: Line spread
line_std_weight.description: Penalty multiplier for this role's line-strength standard deviation across teams.
